clusters.title: MI355X disagg server startup fails: "memory capacity is unbalanced" (GPUs held by outside processes) — 7 legs, D2

details.label: Status
details.text: `[FACT]`:
`_check_tp_memory_balance` (`bootstrap.py:450`) raised before the model load, with `pre_model_load_memory=0.4–88 GB` against 277 GB.
The node was `pit2-p03-g11` (GPUs 0–5) between about 07:39 and 08:20 UTC, and `pit2-p03-g16` at 07:30.
The same SHA, image and node passed the check at 07:22, at 07:27 and from 08:24 on.
These legs also carry the R281 ImportError, which this earlier crash hides.

details.label: Top hypothesis
details.text: `[MEDIUM]`: an infrastructure problem.
Something outside the job held about 245 GB on each affected GPU.
`[SPECULATION]` One candidate is orphaned TP workers from the `dsv4pro-fp8-1k1k-1p1d` prefill, whose container was force-removed at about 07:31.

details.label: Disconfirming
details.text: the process holding the memory was never identified, because the launcher runs no `rocm-smi --showpids` and no VRAM check.

details.label: In-flight fix
details.text: ❌ none found. Searched `memory+capacity+unbalanced`, `launch_mi355x` and `mi355x+stale`.

details.label: Suggested triage
details.text: inspect `pit2-p03-g11`/`g16` for leftover containers. Consider a pre-launch VRAM-free check in `scripts/ci/slurm/launch_mi355x.sh`.

cause_prs.title: [Perf] logits: Write lm_head logits straight into the fp32 logits buffer

fix_prs.author: YAMY1234
fix_prs.title: [Fix] logits: Preserve lm_head precision with shared buffers

details.label: Status
details.text: `[FACT]`:
The test passed in S at `9301ca37` and failed in T at `81841d6b` and in both U lanes. The window has 47 commits.
The ROUGE-L score is identical on rocm10, rocm720 and rocm724 (`0.6096866…`, batch 1 prompt 1), so the failure is deterministic.

details.label: Top hypothesis
details.text: `[MEDIUM]`: [#45631](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45631) ([`f1e26dc6`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/commit/f1e26dc658bea745e8e83ee8bd37a11c212fc810)) changed the lm_head path in `logits_processor.py`. When a matching fp32 logits buffer exists, it now computes `torch.mm(..., out_dtype=float32)` even with FP32 lm_head disabled, which changes the rounding.
It is in the S→T window.
The follow-up fix [#45855](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45855) names "LoRA/UNO parity failures" as its target.

details.label: Disconfirming
details.text: the fix has not yet been confirmed on AMD. [#44001](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44001) ([`9569a365`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/commit/9569a3656155a34dc763826b1608f247d3f66832)), which gates `--prefill-decode-interval` on batch size, is in the same window.

details.label: In-flight fix
details.text: ✅ [#45855](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45855) merged at 19:46 UTC as [`d67d1ae0`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/commit/d67d1ae02c2c9f62757289e6453df29bc98082c7). It is not in U's SHA.

details.label: Suggested triage
details.text: check `stage-b-test-1-gpu-large-amd (*, 1)` in the next pr-test run. If it still fails, bisect `9301ca37..81841d6b`.
